name: xingtai-li-homepage
description: Xingtai Li's personal portfolio. Static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; no runtime dependencies.

scripts.format: prettier --write index.html resume.html styles.css resume.css script.js scripts/*.mjs tests/*.js playwright.config.js package.json && prettier --write assets/favicon.svg --parser html
